name: Execute final PR 10 fixes
on:
  push:
    branches: [feat/weather-operations]
    paths: [.github/workflows/pr10-execute.yml]
permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
jobs:
  execute:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: feat/weather-operations
          fetch-depth: 100
      - name: Verify requested head is an ancestor
        shell: bash
        run: git merge-base --is-ancestor a126797f0c297a4bed3dec6fc4f2d961e57a3584 HEAD
      - name: Apply guarded fixes
        shell: python
        run: |
          from pathlib import Path
          import textwrap
          workflow = Path('.github/workflows/pr10-final-findings.yml').read_text()

          first_start = workflow.index('      - name: Apply scoped area cleanup first')
          first_run = workflow.index('        run: |\n', first_start) + len('        run: |\n')
          first_end = workflow.index('\n      - name: Validate first scoped change', first_run)
          exec(compile(textwrap.dedent(workflow[first_run:first_end]), 'scoped-cleanup', 'exec'))

          apply_start = workflow.index('      - name: Apply remaining fixes and regression tests')
          apply_run = workflow.index('        run: |\n', apply_start) + len('        run: |\n')
          apply_end = workflow.index('\n      - name: Set up Node 24', apply_run)
          script = textwrap.dedent(workflow[apply_run:apply_end])
          schedule_start = script.index('# Reconcile one schedule and remove every duplicate.')
          schedule_end = script.index('# Add schedule duplicate regression cases', schedule_start)
          schedule_patch = '''# Reconcile one schedule and remove every duplicate.
          sync_path = Path('Raw/workspace-reset/sync_workspace_from_git.py')
          sync_text = sync_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          selection_start = sync_text.index('    schedules = response.json().get("value", [])')
          selection_end = sync_text.index('    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)', selection_start)
          selection = "\\n".join([
              '    schedules = response.json().get("value", [])',
              '    retained = next((schedule for schedule in schedules if weather_schedule_matches(schedule)), None)',
              '    if retained is None and schedules:',
              '        retained = schedules[0]',
              '',
          ])
          sync_text = sync_text[:selection_start] + selection + sync_text[selection_end:]
          action_start = sync_text.index('    if schedules:', selection_start)
          action_end = sync_text.index('\\n\\n\\ndef configure_weather_assets', action_start)
          action = "\\n".join([
              '    if retained is None:',
              '        response = fab.request("POST", base, json=body)',
              '        action = "created"',
              '    elif weather_schedule_matches(retained):',
              '        response = None',
              '        action = "reused"',
              '    else:',
              '        schedule_id = retained.get("id")',
              '        if not schedule_id:',
              '            raise SystemExit(f"Existing \\'{WEATHER_PIPELINE_NAME}\\' schedule has no id.")',
              '        response = fab.request("PATCH", f"{base}/{schedule_id}", json=body)',
              '        action = "updated"',
              '    if response is not None and response.status_code not in (200, 201):',
              '        raise SystemExit(',
              '            f"Failed to configure \\'{WEATHER_PIPELINE_NAME}\\' schedule: "',
              '            f"HTTP {response.status_code} {response.text}"',
              '        )',
              '',
              '    for schedule in schedules:',
              '        if schedule is retained:',
              '            continue',
              '        schedule_id = schedule.get("id")',
              '        if not schedule_id:',
              '            raise SystemExit(f"Extra \\'{WEATHER_PIPELINE_NAME}\\' schedule has no id.")',
              '        deleted = fab.request("DELETE", f"{base}/{schedule_id}")',
              '        if deleted.status_code not in (200, 204):',
              '            raise SystemExit(',
              '                f"Failed to delete extra \\'{WEATHER_PIPELINE_NAME}\\' schedule {schedule_id}: "',
              '                f"HTTP {deleted.status_code} {deleted.text}"',
              '            )',
              '    print(f"{WEATHER_PIPELINE_NAME} schedule {action}: every six hours (UTC).")',
          ])
          sync_path.write_text(sync_text[:action_start] + action + sync_text[action_end:], encoding='utf-8')

          '''
          script = script[:schedule_start] + schedule_patch + script[schedule_end:]
          exec(compile(script, 'remaining-fixes', 'exec'))
          schedule_test_path = Path('Raw/workspace-reset/test_sync_workspace_from_git.py')
          schedule_test_text = schedule_test_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          schedule_test_start = schedule_test_text.index('    def test_matching_schedule_is_retained_and_stale_duplicate_is_deleted')
          schedule_test_end = schedule_test_text.index('    def test_already_published_environment_is_not_republished_without_git_update', schedule_test_start)
          corrected_schedule_tests = '    def test_matching_schedule_is_retained_and_stale_duplicate_is_deleted(self):\n        fabric = FakeFabric()\n        existing = FakeResponse(200, {"value": [\n            {"id": "valid", "enabled": True, "configuration": {\n                "type": "Cron", "interval": 360, "localTimeZoneId": "UTC",\n                "startDateTime": "2026-09-16T03:20:00Z",\n            }},\n            {"id": "stale", "enabled": True, "configuration": {\n                "type": "Cron", "interval": 240, "localTimeZoneId": "UTC",\n                "startDateTime": "2026-09-16T03:00:00Z",\n            }},\n        ]})\n        original_request = fabric.request\n        fabric.request = Mock(side_effect=lambda method, url, **kwargs: existing\n            if method == "GET" and "/jobs/Pipeline/schedules" in url\n            else original_request(method, url, **kwargs))\n\n        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):\n            configure_weather_schedule(fabric, "workspace-id", "weather-pipeline")\n\n        writes = [(call.args[0], call.args[1]) for call in fabric.request.call_args_list if call.args[0] != "GET"]\n        self.assertEqual([method for method, _ in writes], ["DELETE"])\n        self.assertTrue(writes[0][1].endswith("/stale"))\n\n    def test_multiple_stale_schedules_repairs_one_and_deletes_extras(self):\n        fabric = FakeFabric()\n        existing = FakeResponse(200, {"value": [\n            {"id": "keep", "enabled": False, "configuration": {}},\n            {"id": "extra-one", "enabled": True, "configuration": {"type": "Cron", "interval": 240}},\n            {"id": "extra-two", "enabled": True, "configuration": {"type": "Cron", "interval": 120}},\n        ]})\n        original_request = fabric.request\n        fabric.request = Mock(side_effect=lambda method, url, **kwargs: existing\n            if method == "GET" and "/jobs/Pipeline/schedules" in url\n            else original_request(method, url, **kwargs))\n\n        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):\n            configure_weather_schedule(fabric, "workspace-id", "weather-pipeline")\n\n        writes = [(call.args[0], call.args[1]) for call in fabric.request.call_args_list if call.args[0] != "GET"]\n        self.assertEqual([method for method, _ in writes], ["PATCH", "DELETE", "DELETE"])\n        self.assertTrue(writes[0][1].endswith("/keep"))\n        self.assertEqual({url.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] for _, url in writes[1:]}, {"extra-one", "extra-two"})\n\n'
          schedule_test_path.write_text(schedule_test_text[:schedule_test_start] + corrected_schedule_tests + schedule_test_text[schedule_test_end:], encoding='utf-8')
      - name: Validate first scoped change
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python -m py_compile Notebooks/Weather_002_fetch_area_weather.Notebook/notebook-content.py
          python - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          text = Path('Notebooks/Weather_002_fetch_area_weather.Notebook/notebook-content.py').read_text()
          assert 'if not selected_facility_ids:\n    active_area_ids' in text
          PY
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: HydroOperationsApp/package-lock.json
      - name: Validate Python notebooks and JSON
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python -m py_compile Notebooks/Weather_002_fetch_area_weather.Notebook/notebook-content.py Notebooks/Weather_020_area_calculations.Notebook/notebook-content.py
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          json.loads(Path('Raw/RTI_Notebooks/RTI_001_create_lakehouse_SelfContained.ipynb').read_text())
          json.loads(Path('Orchestrator_Pipelines/03_Pipe_Weather.DataPipeline/pipeline-content.json').read_text())
          PY
          (cd Raw/workspace-reset && python -m unittest test_sync_workspace_from_git test_deploy_fabric_app test_weather_source_contracts)
      - name: Validate frontend without deployment prehooks
        working-directory: HydroOperationsApp
        shell: bash
        run: |
          npm ci --ignore-scripts
          npm run typecheck
          node --import tsx --test scripts/weather-summary.test.ts
          node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
          npx eslint src/ui-shared/pages/WeatherPage.tsx src/ui-shared/weatherSummary.ts src/services/fabric.ts scripts/weather-summary.test.ts
          npx vite build
      - name: Update PR description
        shell: python
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          import json, os, re, urllib.request
          url = 'https://api.github.com/repos/dibakardharchoudhury/FabricIQAppsDEMO/pulls/10'
          headers = {'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json', 'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['GITHUB_TOKEN']}", 'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28'}
          with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers)) as response:
              pull = json.load(response)
          replacement = ('Treats the current Entra SPA redirect snapshot as authoritative, then adds only the current hosting origin and localhost to `rayfin.yml`; stale local-only origins are removed rather than restored.')
          body, count = re.subn(r'Changes Rayfin redirect handling to merge existing `rayfin\.yml` origins with Entra/current deployment origins, preserving teammate app URLs\s+while validating only tenant-relevant Entra redirects\.', replacement, pull['body'])
          if count != 1:
              raise SystemExit(f'Expected one conflicting PR statement, found {count}')
          request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=json.dumps({'body': body}).encode(), headers={**headers, 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='PATCH')
          urllib.request.urlopen(request).close()
      - name: Commit fixes and remove temporary artifacts
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          git rm .github/workflows/pr10-final-findings.yml .github/workflows/pr10-pinpoint.yml .github/workflows/pr10-execute.yml .github/workflows/pr10-executor-pinpoint.yml .github/pr10-anchor-error.txt .github/pr10-executor-error.txt .github/pr10-execute-fixed.txt
          git add -A
          git commit -m "Fix remaining weather review findings"
          git push origin HEAD:feat/weather-operations
